events.name: Chelsea v Manchester United
events.selectedSentence: Chelsea host Manchester United with Chelsea's Xabi Alonso reset and Manchester United's Carrick rebuild both under examination.
events.fullSpiel: Chelsea arrives with 3W-1D-2L, while Manchester United brings 1W-3D-2L. Chelsea begin the Xabi Alonso era without European fixtures, giving a new tactical project more training time but leaving defensive resilience as an immediate test. Manchester United entered Michael Carrick's first full season after finishing third, with a rebuilt midfield and Champions League football returning. That makes this fixture a direct test of a new three-at-the-back project without European midweeks against a redesigned midfield carrying Champions League load, and the next result will advance both season threads.
